subject: Integrated lighting and accessory storage
hook: Fitted wardrobes with lighting and storage planned in
gbp:
Planning fitted wardrobes and want them to work as well inside as they look outside? SUPERIO Furniture designs and builds bespoke fitted wardrobes for homes in Sandbach and the surrounding area, with lighting and accessory storage planned in from the start.

We design the interior around what you own and how you get ready:
- Lighting positioned to light your clothes, with hidden cable routes planned through the units for your electrician to connect
- Shallow drawers with dividers for jewellery, watches and accessories
- Pull-out shoe shelves, trouser rails, and tie or belt racks
- Soft-close doors and drawers as standard

Wardrobes can be hinged or sliding, in finishes from matt white to oak-effect and black woodgrain.

Every wardrobe goes through a free, no-obligation design consultation, measuring and an itemised quote, manufacture in our own Hanley workshop, and installation by our own team.

Book a consultation to plan yours.
